about: Pull camp behind the zone line. At a dungeon's first pull, the only cleared ground behind the tank is the entrance, so ComputeSafeCamp, ComputeTrailCamp and the scout trail point planted the camp on or past the instance-exit areatrigger. The navmesh cannot see areatriggers, so IsNavReachable passed it, and a self-bot was teleported out mid-run (memory dc-camp-behind-zone-line). Fixed in 1426f78c (S1655, merged in 7d1ca40d): DcZoneLine point and segment gates sit beside CampBlockedByDoor at every camp site. The scenario starts the party on SFK's zone-in point (areatrigger_teleport 145) and forces an advanced pull on the first pack, 17-22yd ahead. The exit trigger (areatrigger 194, r5 at -231.0,2105.1) is 4yd behind the party. Headless bots never send CMSG_AREATRIGGER, so the transfer cannot fire here. O6/O10 catch a camp walk that wedges against the exit; the trace's camp point shows the gate directly.
